title: Blackened Treant and Blackened Dryad
summary: A blackened treant breaks apart into limbs before the dryad emerges.
overview: A blackened treant breaks apart into limbs before the dryad emerges.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Defeat the Blackened Treant, then gather the Blackened Tree Limbs that replace it.
The limbs lead to the Blackened Dryad. Keep the group together through the successive spawns so the new target does not reach an unprepared player.
The dryad casts Withering Glare seven seconds after engagement and every twenty seconds thereafter. Keep healing ready for the top-hate target.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
